comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Out of curiosity, I took a look at this on GVDB: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=5990

In short, it seems like you need either a transmuted item with Age effect (18th century) EX Effect or the Boston skill listed by Tammer. I suspect the problem may be that 18th Century, period 3 title doesn't work due to the discovery being considered part of a 'different' 18th Century era -- except no quests in-game right now give other 18th Century period titles.

Seems like an odd thing to release a discovery which would so difficult to find without special equipment or skills, but so it (currently) seems to go. There was an odd note on GVDB about "16th century BC" but I can't tell what it means -- maybe just ruling out those time title periods for helping find the discovery as well? Cheers.

wiki:
Required Skills: Recognition 7R / Astronomy 9R
Required Age: Age effect (16th century) 4 Phase, Night
Location: Jutland Peninsula, Open Sea
